_meta.capture_method: Direct fetch() via javascript_tool. read_network_requests does not expose request/response bodies. Empty-option default test recreated via `wp option delete dokan_withdraw` + GET via `dokan_get_setting_values`.

empty_option_default.verdict: Only `withdraw_methods` returns. `set_withdraw_limit_gateways` injected `paypal => paypal` default and parsed against all known methods (everything else `''`). No other declared fields appear in response — they fall back to `get_option(..., [])` empty array.

negative_full_payload.note: `stripe` key (sent in payload) was DROPPED. It is not in `dokan_withdraw_get_methods()` so sanitize/parse_args strips it on the read filter. DB persists only what `set_withdraw_limit_gateways` recognises.

errors.name: withdraw_method_name
errors.error: Method name can not be empty

errors.name: withdraw_method_type
errors.error: Method type can not be empty

custom_blank_validation.verdict: Pro short-circuits save with `wp_send_json_error` BEFORE update_option is called. DB unchanged.

all_methods_disabled.request: withdraw_methods={} (empty object → POST body sends settingsData[withdraw_methods]= as a single empty value)
all_methods_disabled.raw_db_after: wp_options.dokan_withdraw → withdraw_methods serialized as s:0:"" (empty STRING, not empty array). Confirmed via `wp db query`.
all_methods_disabled.verdict: Empty multicheck payload sanitises to '' in DB. On READ, `set_withdraw_limit_gateways` runs `wp_parse_args('', all_methods)` which returns all method ids with '' values. Server never re-injects PayPal default when option exists but methods are empty — empty-option default ONLY fires when `dokan_withdraw` is fully absent.

errors.name: withdraw_limit
errors.error: Minimum Withdraw Limit can't be negative value.

withdraw_limit_negative_1.verdict: Rejected at validation. Source: includes/Withdraw/Hooks.php or admin save-validation hook listening on `dokan_save_settings_value` (validates `withdraw_limit < 0`).

withdraw_limit_zero.verdict: Accepted. `0` is treated as 'no minimum limit' by downstream consumers (dokan_get_option default fallbacks). Round-trips as `'0'` (string).

restore_state: After all sub-cases, Save A sentinels were re-applied (status 200, success). Subsequent tasks see a stable post-Save-A state.
